items.headline: NASA Selects 19 New Citizen…
summaries: NASA reports: So far, 2026 has seen a flood of successes for volunteers who do NASA science, exemplifying NASA’s commitment to gold-standard science—transparent, reproducible and intrinsically collaborative.
NASA reports: The Backyard Worlds: Planet 9 project announced that their project volunteers have now discovered most of the known brown dwarfs, celestial objects that are similar to planets.
NASA reports: The Zooniverse platform, with grant from NASA, reached a milestone of 1 billion classifications.

items.headline: Employment declines reported
summaries: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reports: Unemployment rates were lower in September than a year earlier in 226 of the 387 metropolitan areas, higher in 138 areas, and unchanged in 23 areas, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reports: A total of 48 areas had jobless rates of less than 3.0 percent, and 5 areas had rates of at least 8.0 percent.
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reports: Over the year, employment decreased in Washington-Arlington-Alexandria, DC-VA-MD-WV (-1.8 percent).

items.headline: FTC and States Take Action…
summaries: Federal Trade Commission reports: Toast markets and sells point-of-sale hardware and software and payment processing services to small businesses in the restaurant industry.
Federal Trade Commission reports: Toast’s cloud-based products and services are used to take and manage orders, accept payments and track inventory, among other related services.

Federal Trade Commission reports: The FTC and state co-plaintiffs allege Toast deceives customers by imposing various types of fees on the cost of its hardware and software, which Toast fails to clearly disclose to its customers.
